sentences.text:
THIS CRIMINAL PETITION COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY, ORDER IS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 ORAL ORDER (PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE G BASAVARAJA) Petitioner/accused has field this petition under section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail as the accused is in Judicial Custody in S.C.No.5040/2024, on the file of I Additional District and Sessions Judge, Dharwad, sitting at Hubballi, for the offence punishable under sections 376 and 450 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC' for short) as the accused is in Judicial Custody from 01.02.2024.
2. Learned Additional Government Advocate has filed objections.
3. Heard arguments on both the sides.
NC: 2025:KHC-D:7165 4.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner has reiterated the averments/grounds urged in the memorandum of bail petition.
5. Learned Additional Government Advocate has also urged the averments made in the statement of objections.

6. On the basis of the complaint filed by the victim, Ashok Nagar Police have registered a case in Crime No.8/2024 and submitted FIR to the Court for the offence punishable under sections 376 and 450 of IPC.
After investigation, the Investigating Officer submitted charge sheet against the accused for the offence punishable under sections 376 and 450 of IPC.
